build_falcon_h1_causal_lm: build a FalconH1ForCausalLM model with config, quantization config, and prefix for causal language modeling
create_falcon_h1_decoder_layer: create a FalconH1HybridAttentionDecoderLayer with config, layer id, quant config, and alt stream for hybrid attention and Mamba mixing
create_falcon_h1_mlp: create a FalconH1MLP module with hidden size, intermediate size, activation, and mlp multipliers for gated feed-forward computation
load_falcon_h1_weights: load FalconH1ForCausalLM model weights from an iterable of name-tensor pairs with stacked param splitting for qkv and gate_up projections
run_falcon_h1_forward: run a FalconH1ForCausalLM forward pass with input ids, positions, forward batch, and optional inputs embeds to generate logits
